captions.detailed: A 3D model of a communications blimp, featuring a large, elongated cigar-shaped gas envelope in light grey. Beneath the main hull is a rectangular equipment gondola in dark grey, which supports a small wheeled landing gear assembly under its carriage. The tail features four fins (vertical and horizontal control surfaces) arranged in a cross configuration. Two propulsion pods with propellers are mounted on the sides of the gondola, designed to rotate continuously on their local axes, while the vertical rudder and horizontal tail fins are articulated to pivot on their respective hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a communications blimp with a cigar-shaped main gas envelope, a rectangular equipment gondola suspended beneath it, side engine pods with propellers, and a four-fin tail assembly. The model should include articulation joints for continuous rotation of the propellers and landing wheels, as well as revolute joints for the vertical rudder and horizontal control surfaces.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp by first modeling the main gas envelope using a loft or revolved profile to create the cigar shape. The rectangular gondola is created using a Box primitive and positioned beneath the envelope centerline. The tail fins and control surfaces are modeled using extruded profiles and attached to the rear of the envelope with revolute joints. The propulsion pods and propellers are built using Cylinders and Box primitives, then connected to the sides of the gondola via continuous rotational joints. Finally, the landing gear struts and wheels are modeled using Cylinders and attached underneath the gondola.
